pages.text: Fluid Storage Blocks provide dedicated storage for fluids in your Refined Storage network. Like their item counterparts, these blocks can be placed in the world and retain their contents when broken. They integrate seamlessly with fluid handling components and won't despawn when dropped.

Features include:$(br)$(li)Configurable Priority Settings$(li)Fluid Whitelist/Blacklist Options$(li)NBT Filtering Support$(li)Multiple Operation Modes$(br2)Access stored fluids using a $(l:fluid_grid)Fluid Grid$() or manage them through fluid handling components like the $(l:fluid_interface)Fluid Interface$().
64k Fluid Storage Block - Stores 64,000 mB of fluids
256k Fluid Storage Block - Stores 256,000 mB of fluids
1024k Fluid Storage Block - Stores 1,024,000 mB of fluids
4096k Fluid Storage Block - Stores 4,096,000 mB of fluids
